statement: At the pinned inspected revisions, Cemu's native Wiimote messages header defines output report IDs 0x14, 0x18 and 0x19 and a speaker status flag, but WiimoteControllerProvider.cpp has no speaker send/configuration path. WiimoteLib's pinned Wiimote.cs defines no speaker output command or A2 speaker register and no speaker sample producer; its generic report 0x22 handler and status wait are unrelated to an audio stream. These files therefore supply no positive speaker-stream acceptance oracle; they remain input/status consumers, not confirmed audio originators.

applicability.revision: Original Wii Remote consumer protocol paths; no retail revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. No host or hardware execution; speaker source-only consumer analysis; tests and proposed experiments not run. See docs/wii-speaker-consumers.md for pinned locators and bounded inferences.
